label: Interpretive contribution mapping based on role characteristics and official UN SDG definitions.

Business Intelligence Analysts.title: Decent Work and Economic Growth
Business Intelligence Analysts.rationale: Business intelligence can help organizations use information to improve productivity and make more informed operating decisions.

Business Intelligence Analysts.title: Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure
Business Intelligence Analysts.rationale: Reliable analysis supports data-informed innovation and the improvement of organizational systems.

Data Scientists.title: Decent Work and Economic Growth
Data Scientists.rationale: Applied data analysis can support productivity and evidence-informed decisions in organizations.

Data Scientists.title: Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure
Data Scientists.rationale: Data science methods can contribute to research, technological capability, and innovation.

Statisticians.title: Decent Work and Economic Growth
Statisticians.rationale: Statistical evidence can help employers and institutions evaluate outcomes and make better-informed decisions.

Statisticians.title: Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure
Statisticians.rationale: Sound measurement and statistical methods support research and innovation.

Actuaries.title: Decent Work and Economic Growth
Actuaries.rationale: Risk assessment can support financial planning and the resilience of economic organizations.

Economists.title: Decent Work and Economic Growth
Economists.rationale: Economic analysis can inform decisions about productivity, employment, and sustainable economic activity.

Market Research Analysts and Marketing S.title: Decent Work and Economic Growth
Market Research Analysts and Marketing S.rationale: Market evidence can help organizations understand demand and make more informed product and service decisions.

Market Research Analysts and Marketing S.title: Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure
Market Research Analysts and Marketing S.rationale: Research into customer needs can inform the development and improvement of products and services.

Accountants and Auditors.title: Decent Work and Economic Growth
Accountants and Auditors.rationale: Accurate financial records and audit work support accountable, productive organizations.

Accountants and Auditors.title: Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
Accountants and Auditors.rationale: Transparent reporting and assurance can strengthen accountability in organizations and institutions.

Management Analysts.title: Decent Work and Economic Growth
Management Analysts.rationale: Management analysis can identify ways for organizations to improve their operations and productivity.

Financial Quantitative Analysts.title: Decent Work and Economic Growth
Financial Quantitative Analysts.rationale: Quantitative financial analysis supports informed assessment of economic and investment decisions.

Financial Quantitative Analysts.title: Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure
Financial Quantitative Analysts.rationale: Quantitative models and data systems contribute to analytical capability and financial innovation.

Loan Officers.title: Decent Work and Economic Growth
Loan Officers.rationale: Responsible credit assessment can support access to financing for households and businesses.

Financial Examiners.title: Decent Work and Economic Growth
Financial Examiners.rationale: Financial oversight can help support sound, resilient financial organizations.

Financial Examiners.title: Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
Financial Examiners.rationale: Examination and compliance work can contribute to accountable financial institutions.

essential.title: Quality Education
essential.rationale: Developing occupational skills is an ongoing learning activity that supports access to relevant skills.

essential.title: Decent Work and Economic Growth
essential.rationale: Role-specific skills can support readiness for productive work.

transferable.title: Quality Education
transferable.rationale: Transferable skills can be developed through lifelong learning and applied across work settings.

transferable.title: Decent Work and Economic Growth
transferable.rationale: Problem-solving, communication, and coordination can support effective participation in work.

knowledge.title: Quality Education
knowledge.rationale: Building relevant subject knowledge is part of access to useful learning and skills development.

knowledge.title: Decent Work and Economic Growth
knowledge.rationale: Applied occupational knowledge can support productive work and informed decisions.

technology.title: Quality Education
technology.rationale: Learning relevant digital tools is an area for continuing skills development.

technology.title: Decent Work and Economic Growth
technology.rationale: Digital technology skills can support effective participation in changing workplaces.

technology.title: Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure
technology.rationale: The responsible use of digital tools can contribute to innovation and stronger analytical systems.
